name: Konya Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi
summary: Konya Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi manufactures and sells cement, Portland cement, clinker, and ready mixed concrete in Central Anatolia and the Mediterranean Region. It also offers labor, testing and analysis services, as well as engages in collecting, transforming, and evaluating waste for material and energy industry. The company was founded in 1954 and is based in Konya, Turkey. Konya Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi is a subsidiary of Parficim S.A.S.
